title: solenocarpus philippinensis

This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, the exact bioactive constituents of S. philippinensis are not well-studied, and further research is needed to confirm its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
